text: When a family says yes to a membership during the visit, enroll the pet right there. The first month goes on today's bill, so the family pays once, at checkout.
Remember: read the amount to the owner before you enroll, then collect it at checkout with the visit.
On Juniper's chart, in the Membership section, click Enroll in a plan.
Hand the screen to the owner. They read the agreement first.
It covers each plan, the twelve-month commitment, and what happens if they cancel early.
They tick that they agree,
draw their signature,
and type their full name.
Enrolling prices today's visit at member rates, and adds the first month to today's invoice.
Monthly plans need a card for the months after. Maria's card on file is chosen. It isn't charged today.
Scout only lists plans for Juniper's species and age. Pick Feline Foundations, monthly, fifty-nine dollars.
Click Enroll.
Scout confirms: fifty-nine dollars goes on today's invoice, and Stripe bills her card every month, starting next month. Read it to Maria.
Click Enroll and add to the invoice.
Juniper is a member, and her benefits already apply to today's visit. Until the invoice is paid, the section says Awaiting payment.
At checkout, the wellness visit, trip fee and vaccine are covered, and the membership is a line on the same bill.
Click Card on file,
and charge Maria's card once, for the visit and the first month.
Paid. Back on Juniper's chart, Awaiting payment is gone, and Stripe starts billing next month.

The most common mistakes: enrolling before the owner has heard the amount, and picking a plan for the wrong pet. Remember: read the amount to the owner before you enroll, then collect it at checkout with the visit.
